rules.ordinary: raw same-material DPS; multiplier = absolute tier * 1.6 / (head scale * speed)
rules.alternate_modes: validated separately from the primary melee baseline

tools.description: Compact chopping tool with a deliberate, high-damage axe cadence.
Very short-range paired claws; the high tier pays for having to stay on top of the target.
The slowest blunt mining weapon, built around large committed hits.
Heavy multi-block hammer whose Pierce II is credited against the canonical armor mix.
Slow hybrid digging tool rewarded for its short, workmanlike pick swings.
Extremely slow two-handed forestry axe with very high damage per connection.
Broad digging tool using weighty mace swings.
Conventional digging shovel with blunt, single-head mace attacks.
Fast mining pick whose Pierce I receives measured generic armor credit.
Quick pick-adze hybrid with a compact overhead pattern.
Mining pick with a separately budgeted light-crossbow-style charge shot.
Long, slow harvesting sweep; normal cleave is not treated as a DPS substitute.
Two-head combat spade with sword combos, slower and more martial than a shovel.
Fast anchor-like utility ram; its returning throw is tracked separately.
Quick engineering wrench whose convenience does not replace damage.
Material-independent precision tool solved at the zero-head reference point.
Fast harvesting sickle with normalized single- and dual-wield combos.

weapons.description: Short naval blade with close-range cuts and strong payoff per opening.
Shortest conventional blade; fast normalized dual-wield strings offset its reach risk.
Point-blank shield puncher with blocking and a separately tracked throw.
Low-impact rapid ranged chassis; its projectile baseline gets the short-range/high-friction tier.
Heavy kitchen blade with axe timing and strong single-target cuts.
Classic two-handed cleaver with broad, committed claymore swings.
Slow great blade rewarded with high per-hit damage; ordinary AOE is not penalized.
Extremely slow exotic blade with the catalogue's largest ordinary hit commitment.

weapons.exception: Native +7 sprint charge remains intentionally unnerfed as an epic signature.
weapons.description: Two-headed double axe with a preserved sprint-charge burst.
Slow polearm with glaive sweeps and useful reach.
Versatile poleaxe pattern balancing thrusts and chops.
Blocking sign used as a mace; charged Bonk has its own lower budget.
Melee-capable crystal staff preserving its caster identity.
Thrusting spear with a throw that shares its per-hit damage budget.
Twin-blade melee form with a separately tracked returning throw.
One-handed melee wand using the Epic Fight Sword form.
Quick light bow normalized below its old projectile baseline.
Fluid-powered light crossbow proxy; fluid effects remain outside baseline E-DPS.
Central reference sword; 100 now means 90% of the former flat baseline.
Estoc with a generic armor-bypassing secondary hit, solved against canonical armor.
Heavy-bow ranged reference at the new central baseline.
Heavy-crossbow ranged reference at the new central baseline.
Fast, long staff held to 95—not 90—because it has no armor-piercing innate.
Fast two-head sword with fluid reach and cadence.
Very fast thrusting weapon; multi-head scaling is preserved without runaway DPS.
Fast long-reach spear, modestly below the centre because reach is consistently valuable.
Fast one-handed 3.5-reach lance with Pierce I; the sole 90-tier chassis.
